captions.detailed: This 3D model is a rolling pin spacer designed as a low-profile, split-ring collar. It features a thin, wide hollow cylinder with a uniform wall thickness. A clean, angled slit cuts entirely through one side of the ring, allowing it to flex and easily slip onto the end of a rolling pin.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric rolling pin spacer ring in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the rolling pin diameter and the desired dough thickness (which determines the spacer's wall thickness). Include a small, angled cut-out slot on one side of the ring to make it flexible and easy to slide onto the pin.
captions.factory: The code uses a difference() operation to construct the split spacer ring. First, a large outer cylinder is created with a radius equal to the rolling pin radius plus the dough thickness. A smaller inner cylinder representing the rolling pin is translated and subtracted to hollow out the ring. Finally, a thin cube is rotated by 30 degrees and translated to cut an angled slot through one side of the ring.
